maddeler.e:
أتقارب (form VI)
# أَتَقَارَبُ (ʔataqārabu) /ʔa.ta.qaː.ra.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَقَارَبَ (taqāraba)
# أَتَقَارَبَ (ʔataqāraba) /ʔa.ta.qaː.ra.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَقَارَبَ (taqāraba)
# أَتَقَارَبْ (ʔataqārab) /ʔa.ta.qaː.rab/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَقَارَبَ (taqāraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
